# Unitalic gizmo

`Gizmo: giz-unitalic` `LIVE`

## What it does

Reaches for the footnote form and misses it by a space. Markdown will not read an underscore with a space against it,
so the line below is not italic and the underscores reach the page. The citation still parses, so the one finding this
record produces stands against the line. The field reports nothing about the id it lists.

### The humming part

Sets the pitch, and holds it.

_**Covers:** [giz-behaving].it-hums _
